## APK testing

For each change in the pull request, a workflow is run, which produces a debug artifact APK. Go to Checks -> Drift CI -> `app-debug.apk` and download the APK. It installs under the `io.github.seshuthota.drift.debug` namespace and will not mess with your main installation.
